summary: Keep Mealie recipes handy in a counter-friendly cooking view.
page_description: A Mealie companion that keeps tonight's recipe legible, awake, and usable offline at the counter.
release_notes: A Mealie companion that keeps tonight's recipe legible, awake, and usable offline at the counter.

steps.text: Make the Mealie API available to the Kobo at https://mealie.local.
Create a long-lived Mealie API token and install it under the exact name mealie.
